what: Bundles produced by an ORPHANED stress arm whose server had already been shut down. Not evidence of any product or navigation behaviour.
cause: A watcher trimming the arm killed nav-stress.mjs but not its npm exec playwright grandchildren, which survived with PPID 1 and kept running against a dead server for ~25 minutes.
whyKept: The recorder classified all of them at REQUEST_STARTED — the browser issued the request, the server never received it (section 23) — which is exactly what an unreachable server must look like, and is instantly separable from the failure under investigation. Before this instrumentation every one would have been an indistinguishable page.goto timeout.
screenshotsRemoved: Yes — 23 screenshots of an unreachable page, 1.6 MB, carry no information. One complete bundle is retained as an exemplar.
